Embroidered old shoes.
The embroidery was the original texture, the oldness was the passage of time.
When the father gave these shoes away, he adorned the tips with two luminous pearls.
They were a meeting gift from a powerful official to this wandering swordsman.
The "Shocking Waves Palm" master had never received such a heavy gift. After much deliberation, he finally attached them to his daughter's new shoes.
But Lan Ao tore off the pearls and threw the extravagant jewelry away. The pearls rolled clattering down the greasy corridor of the inn, still shining brightly.
Whether it was the father who accepted the gift in confusion or the daughter who disliked it without understanding why,
at that time, neither knew that all gifts from those in power come at a steep price.
